acceptance_evidence: CCA verdict and MergeGate evidence are recorded before completion.
completion_conditions: Each of the fourteen pairs has an assertion that fails when the sites diverge.
Every assertion names both sites and the fix in its failure message.
Every assertion runs green inside a freshly installed target, not only on the platform.
The full suite, the init suite and validate_shiki stay green.

decisions: The pattern was measured, not assumed. `scripts/validate_shiki.py:1892` holds `.shiki/schemas/ledger.schema.json`'s type enum SET-EQUAL to `LEDGER_TYPES`; when a task tried to add a ledger type with only the schema in its locks, that binder failed instantly and named the fix — a cheap, loud failure. By contrast the CCA workflow's inline transport schema had NO binder against `.shiki/schemas/cca-verdict.schema.json`, and six distinct shape violations reached production over two days, each costing one to three CCA re-runs per PR. Same shape, opposite cost, and the difference is entirely whether a binder exists.

Fourteen pairs are in scope; all AGREE today, so the module is green on landing and no other file changes. Ten further pairs are already DIVERGED and are explicitly out of scope — repairing a divergence is the owning task's job, and folding repairs in here would make a test-only task carry behaviour changes.
Assertions must be SET-EQUALITY, never needle or containment, except where the audit found containment is the correct relation (the prose sites in pair 5, and the subset relation in pair 11).

Every assertion must be TARGET-VALID: it may read only artifacts that ship (`scripts/shiki_installer.py` `TEMPLATE_PATHS`) and must tolerate an empty `.shiki` mirror. `scripts/test_shiki_init.sh:383` runs the installed target's `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`, so a platform-only assertion would need a `TARGET_INSTALL_EXCLUDES` entry (`shiki_installer.py:161`) — which is outside these locks and would make the task unsatisfiable.

LOCK-SUFFICIENCY CHECK (2026-08-04). MUST-CHANGE: `tests/test_paired_invariants.py` only. Verified: `tests/test_install_completeness.py`'s `classify()` (`:130-138`) returns None for `tests/…`, so a new test file needs no `TEMPLATE_PATHS` entry; `tests` ships as a whole directory (`shiki_installer.py:41`); nothing in `scripts/validate_shiki.py` enumerates `tests/` (`:1628` pins only the `scripts/test_shiki_*.sh` sweep); `scripts/test_shiki_module_boundaries.sh` is positive-membership over `scripts/`. ONE file, and zero lock conflicts against every other backlog item.

`scripts/validate_shiki.py` is deliberately NOT locked. Binders that must run inside validate_shiki (the mirror-record loops) belong to their own repair tasks, and locking it here would collide with four other backlog items.
No new `scripts/*.py` module may be added: that would require a `TEMPLATE_PATHS` entry (`tests/test_install_completeness.py:183`) and pull `shiki_installer.py` into the locks.

Risk is medium and honest: this adds one test file. It changes no behaviour, no gate, no schema and no workflow. Under `.shiki/guardian-policy.json` (`applies_to_risk: [high, critical]`) neither the Contract PR nor the implementation PR triggers the Guardian gate.
grill_with_docs.source: Enumerated by a repository-wide paired-invariant audit on 2026-08-04, adversarially checked for completeness, and each listed assertion evaluated clean against the tree.

non_goals: Repairing any pair that is already diverged — ten were measured; each belongs to its owning task.
Editing scripts/validate_shiki.py, or adding any binder that must run inside it.
Changing any behaviour, gate, schema or workflow.
Touching any file outside the declared locks.
outcome: Fourteen places where two or more artifacts must agree gain a set-equality assertion, so divergence fails immediately and loudly instead of silently. This is the single highest-recurrence defect class measured in this repository: where a pair is bound, failure is instant and cheap; where nothing binds it, failure is silent and expensive. Every pair listed agrees on the tree today, so the module lands green and changes no other file.
title: Bind every paired invariant that agrees today, before it can silently drift
